listedCourseDetails: [Table Reservation Only (Dinner)] Enjoy world champion exquisite pasta and top-quality seafood directly from Oita a la carte! — JPY 1 （Price including tax）per person. This is a reservation plan for those who wish to freely choose their dishes and drinks based on their mood on the day. Enjoy our exquisite seafood Italian cuisine, featuring dishes made with brand fish directly sourced from Oita and exceptional pasta created by world champion chefs, all available a la carte.

2-Hour All-You-Can-Drink Course: Enjoy 3 Assorted Appetizers, Fritto Misto, and World Champion's Pasta in a 5-Dish Meal — JPY 4,000 （Price including tax）per person. Perfect for first-time visitors to PESCHERIA, this introductory course includes a two-hour all-you-can-drink option. Start with an assortment of three appetizers and today's salad, followed by a platter of freshly fried fritto and homemade gnocchi with house-made sausage and tomatoes, created by a world champion pasta chef. Conclude with a delightful dessert. This five-course meal offers a casual way to enjoy the flavors of Southern Italy and is ideal for welcome and farewell parties or girls' nights out.

2-Hour A la Carte All-You-Can-Drink Plan with Premium Malts and Sparkling Wine! Enjoy with Your Favorite Dishes — JPY 3,000 （Price including tax）per person. This is the perfect "A la carte All-you-can-drink" plan for those who want to choose their dishes based on their mood on the day. Enjoy a wide selection, including the delightful Premium Malts and sparkling wine for toasting, as well as a variety of cocktails. We also offer plenty of non-alcoholic options, such as blood orange. Indulge in exquisite dishes from the world champion of pasta and top-quality seafood delivered directly from Oita, and enjoy at your leisure in your preferred style.

sources.quote: [Table Reservation Only (Dinner)] Enjoy world champion exquisite pasta and top-quality seafood directly from Oita a la carte! This is a reservation plan for those who wish to freely choose their dishes and drinks based on their mood on the day. Enjoy our exquisite seafood Italian cuisine, featuring dishes made with brand fish directly sourced from Oita and exceptional pasta created by world champion chefs, all available a la carte. Reserve Set menu details JPY 1 （Price including tax）per person

All you can drink 2-Hour All-You-Can-Drink Course: Enjoy 3 Assorted Appetizers, Fritto Misto, and World Champion's Pasta in a 5-Dish Meal 5 items Perfect for first-time visitors to PESCHERIA, this introductory course includes a two-hour all-you-can-drink option. Start with an assortment of three appetizers and today's salad, followed by a platter of freshly fried fritto and homemade gnocchi with house-made sausage and tomatoes, created by a world champion pasta chef. Conclude with a delightful dessert. This five-course meal offers a casual way to enjoy the flavors of Southern Italy and is ideal for welcome and farewell parties or girls' nights out. Reserve Set menu details JPY 4,000 （Price including tax）per person

All you can drink 2-Hour A la Carte All-You-Can-Drink Plan with Premium Malts and Sparkling Wine! Enjoy with Your Favorite Dishes 30 items This is the perfect "A la carte All-you-can-drink" plan for those who want to choose their dishes based on their mood on the day. Enjoy a wide selection, including the delightful Premium Malts and sparkling wine for toasting, as well as a variety of cocktails. We also offer plenty of non-alcoholic options, such as blood orange. Indulge in exquisite dishes from the world champion of pasta and top-quality seafood delivered directly from Oita, and enjoy at your leisure in your preferred style.
